meta.name: caveman-compress
meta.description: Compress a memory file such as CLAUDE.md or a todo list into caveman format to save input tokens, keeping a readable backup. Trigger: /caveman-compress.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把记忆文件或待办清单压成极简格式，省下输入字数，同时留一份好读的备份
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你的 agent 记忆文件越写越长、每次都要多花词元，又不想丢掉原文
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your agent memory file keeps growing, costs more tokens each run, and you still want the original kept

howto.what: 把 CLAUDE.md、待办清单、偏好这类自然语言文件压成穴居人式简写,以减少输入 token。压缩版直接覆盖原文件,另存一份可读备份到系统数据目录,不放源文件旁边。
howto.when: 你输入 `/caveman-compress <文件路径>`,或直接要求压缩某个记忆文件时触发。它只处理自然语言文件,遇到代码文件不改。

say.text: 帮我把这份 todo.md 压成穴居人格式
say.note: 只压正文,代码块和命令原样保留。

say.text: 压缩 preferences.md,并保留可读备份

howto.what_en: Compresses natural-language files like CLAUDE.md, todos, or preferences into caveman-speak to cut input tokens. The compressed version overwrites the original; a readable backup is saved in the OS data dir, not beside the source.
howto.when_en: Triggered by `/caveman-compress <filepath>` or when you ask to compress a memory file.

say_en.note: Overwrites the file; backup goes to the data dir.

say_en.text: Compress my todo.md into caveman format
say_en.note: Prose only; code blocks and commands stay exact.

say_en.text: Compress preferences.md and keep a readable backup
